title: Reject invalid sources and expose damaged record history
summary: Source metadata and line bounds are checked before save; malformed records fail cleanly; doctor inspects old revisions; Windows source output no longer doubles line breaks.
body: Reproduced failures before changing code. Dedicated tests now pass: 17 total across memory store and hooks. Invalid source path/hash/bounds cannot create a new record. Corrupt historical records are reported while a valid current version remains readable. Old source hashes remain retrievable/checked without treating a legitimately replaced live source as structural corruption of history. Account usage ended the helper agents; final fixes and verification were completed in the main task. No application behavior change.
change_reason: Record the root causes, fixes and observed tests as one coherent reliability change
